title: Similar Triangles and Constant Slope Core Test
description: Use similar slope triangles to explain why a line has a constant slope.

questions.questionText: A line has one slope triangle with rise 3 and run 2, and a larger slope triangle with rise 6 and run 4. What does this show?
options: The larger triangle has slope 7/4
The slopes are equal because the rise/run ratios are equivalent
The slope changes because the triangle is larger
Only the smaller triangle can be used to find slope
questions.correctAnswer: The slopes are equal because the rise/run ratios are equivalent
questions.explanation: Both triangles give rise/run = 3/2, showing the slope is constant along the same line.

questions.questionText: A line has one slope triangle with rise 2 and run 3, and a larger slope triangle with rise 4 and run 6. What does this show?
options: The slope changes because the triangle is larger
The slopes are equal because the rise/run ratios are equivalent
Only the smaller triangle can be used to find slope
The larger triangle has slope 5/6
questions.correctAnswer: The slopes are equal because the rise/run ratios are equivalent
questions.explanation: Both triangles give rise/run = 2/3, showing the slope is constant along the same line.
